description: List the student groups that have a reservation in this appointment group, returning each as a group object (id, name, group_category_id, members_count) — the same shape list_groups returns. Only meaningful when the group's participant_type is "Group" — a User-type group returns an empty list here; use list_appointment_group_users instead for those. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Find the appointment_group_id with list_appointment_groups.
name: list_appointment_group_groups
title: List Appointment Group Groups
